description: This file declares interfaces for progress tracking in a version control or similar project, including functions to start, display, and stop progress indicators, as well as testing hooks.

methods.name: display_throughput
methods.description: Displays the progress throughput based on the progress struct and total data processed.

methods.name: display_progress
methods.description: Displays the current progress based on the progress struct and current step count.

methods.name: start_progress
methods.description: Initializes and returns a progress struct for a given repository, with specified title and total count.

methods.name: start_sparse_progress
methods.description: Initializes a sparse progress indicator for a repository, with specified title and total.

methods.name: start_delayed_progress
methods.description: Starts progress tracking with delayed activation, for a repository, title, and total.

methods.name: start_delayed_sparse_progress
methods.description: Starts sparse progress tracking with delay, for a repository, title, and total.

methods.name: stop_progress_msg
methods.description: Stops progress display and outputs a specified message.

methods.name: void stop_progress(struct progress ** p_progress)
methods.description: Stops progress display, defaulting to a 'done' message.
